ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'They are hatching a plot' in Surah Al-Imran?
ai.summary: While the verse appears in Surah Al-Imran, it is frequently cited in Shia tafsir as a reference to the Quraysh's plotting against the Prophet (PBUH) and, by extension, the Ahl al-Bayt. This highlights the theme of divine counter-plotting (makr Allah), where God's ultimate plan supersedes the schemes of the disbelievers, a concept deeply resonant with the political and spiritual struggles of the Imams.
